tasks.title: Per-purpose Gmail OAuth scopes (readonly pollers vs send-only sender)
tasks.notes: Split OAuth so pollers use gmail.readonly and the sender uses gmail.send only.

prep.what: Split the existing Gmail OAuth into two scopes — one read-only for polling, one send-only for outbound SMS/email notifications.
prep.understand: How Gmail OAuth scopes work (`gmail.readonly` vs `gmail.send` vs `gmail.modify`); how the current integration uses a single token for both reading inbound and sending outbound; what the security benefit of splitting is.
approach: 1. Review the current Gmail OAuth controller/config — what scopes are requested today and how tokens are stored
2. Create two OAuth registrations in Google API Console: one `gmail.readonly` for pollers, one `gmail.send` for the notification sender
3. Update the OAuth callback/token storage to handle both registrations separately
4. Test both paths: pollers can read but not send, sender can send but cannot read; update tests accordingly
resources: procounters_erp — Gmail OAuth controller, email poller job, notification mailer
Google API Console — OAuth credentials (add separate client for send-only)
Gmail API scopes reference: developers.google.com/gmail/api/auth/scopes

tasks.title: Estimate inline-save auto-SMS — confirm/label or make it a toggle
tasks.phase: UI/UX Overhaul — Jul 17 2026 (held for reveal, NO deploy)
tasks.notes: SHIPPED (commit 49213d0). Added a 'Text the client the new total' toggle to prevent accidental auto-SMS on every inline save.

prep.what: Commit `49213d0` added a 'Text the client the new total' toggle so SMS isn't fired on every estimate inline-save. Verify the toggle works correctly in staging, then close t131 for the batch deploy.
prep.understand: Without this toggle, every inline save would auto-SMS the client with the new estimate total — a bad experience if Haniel is adjusting values mid-session. The toggle should be per-action (not a persistent org setting) and default off.
approach: 1. In staging, open a job with a client phone number and inline-save an estimate with the toggle OFF → confirm no SMS in Twilio logs
2. Toggle ON and save again → confirm the correct 'new total' SMS fires to the right number
3. Refresh the page — toggle should reset to OFF (not persistent across page loads)
4. Mark t131 done if behavior is correct
resources: `git show 49213d0` — find the toggle UI component and SMS dispatch gate
Staging environment + Twilio logs / test SMS dashboard
